resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry and proportions on the visible subject. Translate its silhouette and layers into large asymmetric garment shapes, and repeat its seam curves and closures as front-readable clothing details. One adult full-length editorial photograph before one giant coarse handmade-paper panel with large rope-like visible fibers. Fill its upper two-thirds with solid emerald and its entire lower third with a broad solid garnet horizontal field, all enclosed by a thick metallic-gold frame. Keep calm open spacing and thin haze. Cut one bright continuous white engraved inset line around all four sides of the gold frame and continue it across the floor seam. Preserve natural unmarked skin, coherent hands, believable fabric, natural proportions, cinematic depth, and no text, logos, or watermarks. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has a layered regal silhouette with a tall posture and measured outward volume, a heart-shaped adult face with high cheeks and a gently tapered chin, and long-legged adult proportions with a moderate torso and relaxed shoulder width. The design is unified by subtle botanical seam curves and leaflike closures used as controlled accents. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
